C1.worst_defect: Home says clearly what it is ("Point of sale for Vendure", "Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0") but never says who should not use it or how it compares with the obvious alternatives (Shopify POS, Square, Lightspeed). A buyer has to piece that together from "Before you start" ("only in desktop Chrome", "No coupon codes and no cash drawer").
C1.where: home/desktop/02-03 ("What it does today", "Before you start"); text/home.txt

C2.worst_defect: Nothing on the site says who builds or maintains VendurePOS. The footer says only "Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS", and the demo telemetry goes to ph.wcpos.com without saying why. The only sign of upkeep is the changelog: the last plugin release is "0.3.0 … 2026-10-06", and it admits "Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder". That known bug has gone about six weeks without a patch, and the workaround is repeated on four pages.
C2.where: changelog/desktop/01; home/desktop footer slice; connect-a-till/desktop/01 ("On plugin 0.3.0 that role has no ReadOrder: add it yourself")

C3.worst_defect: Quick start is complete and ordered, with commands and a "Check it worked" list, but it shows no picture of the sign-in screen or of the synced order in the Vendure Dashboard. It also keeps a legacy collapsed block, "If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app", which makes a newcomer wonder which domain is real.

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written in internal jargon a buyer cannot parse: "order.create v5 … (ADR 0005)" and migration names like "TallyPosV51790900000000". Two smaller faults: the Overview's "Next steps" grid omits Connect a till, and At the till lists the camera as a scanner although home's Barcode card names only keyboard-wedge scanners.
C4.where: changelog/desktop/01; docs/desktop/02 (Next steps grid); at-the-till text vs home/desktop/02

C5.worst_defect: Below the two "What it does today" proof cards, the home feature list is two plain text columns that look default next to the polished hero. Docs pages such as plugin-setup and connect-a-till are long walls of text and code with no screenshots.

C6.worst_defect: On the phone, the hero till screenshot is cropped to two product cards, so it no longer shows a sale in progress the way the desktop hero does. Nothing overflows, code wraps, and tables become stacked rows.

C7.worst_defect: Mobile LCP is 2.3 s on / and 2.4 s on /docs/quick-start, the only metric short of top marks (Lighthouse 98/100/100/100). Everything else is in place: JSON-LD, llms.txt, search API, sitemap with lastmod, and a real 404.

overall_worst.defect: A sceptic advising a client cannot judge whether this project will be around in a year. No page says who maintains it, how it is funded, or how it relates to WCPOS/MedusaPOS. The only sign of upkeep is a changelog whose last plugin release is 0.3.0 on 2026-10-06, carrying an admitted, unpatched bug ("in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder"). That bug is handed to the user as a manual workaround on four pages.
overall_worst.fix: Add a two-line "Who builds this / project status" block on home and Overview: the maintainer, the relationship to WCPOS and MedusaPOS, release cadence, and a link to recent commits. Ship 0.3.1 with ReadOrder in the vendurepos-pos-till role so the four workaround notes can go.
